semantic_quality_checks.evidence: 74 source-located records: 70 Table 2 MIC values and 4 hemolysis records from the Low Hemolytic Activity/Figure 8 source surface.
All 128 linked DBAASP assay/experiment/literature rows have primary article metadata plus Table 1/Table 2/Figure 5/Figure 8 locators; no row remains database-only.
The previous hemolysis conflicts were resolved using local XML/PDF text; no unsupported database value was promoted without a source locator.
Direct mechanism is limited to membrane disruption/cell lysis microscopy; time-kill is retained as bactericidal activity evidence, and thanatin LPS context is not promoted.
rwk-complete-test-0001 closed after source-reviewed worker-4/6 repair.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP DBAASPS_19810-19817 rows are reconciled to the paper. MIC rows map to Table 2 by peptide/target; hemolysis rows map to the Low Hemolytic Activity text and Figure 8; sequence/name/modification context is bounded by Table 1, Figure 5, and merged sequence rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 2 supplies MIC values for lantha/lanrip derivatives and controls; hemolysis text supplies exact 128 μM toxicity percentages for lantha, lantha-12, lanrip, and lanrip-12. Duplicate parser scaffold rows were removed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are not overextended: membrane disruption/cell lysis is direct microscopy evidence, time-kill is activity-mode evidence, and prior thanatin LPS/intermembrane-protein discussion remains contextual.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Database sequence notation for lipidated variants uses database-specific X/lipid shorthand; primary source supports parent cores and semisynthetic lipidated structures but exact database notation is preserved rather than normalized.
Hemolysis values are recoverable from local XML/PDF text and Figure 8 context; no figure-only extrapolation was needed.
The paper supports membrane disruption/cell lysis but not a precise molecular target for lantha-12/lanrip-12.
The local supplement PDF was checked and did not add separate activity/toxicity tables affecting final worker-4/6 adjudication.
